item.title: Archival Gravity: How Machine Memory Inherits the World Unevenly
item.description: Notes toward Artificial Intelligence and Human Sacrifice: archival gravity as the structural force by which unevenly preserved, digitized, and tokenized human language bends machine memory toward some lifeworlds while rendering others thin, noisy, or mute.
